question: Which of the following has less opposition to the flow of current?
solution:
The correct answer is __**A good conductor.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Conduction:**

 
• It is the mechanism via which energy is transferred from one medium particle to another.
 
• It can occur in solids, liquids, and gases.
 
• **Conductors are materials that allow the flow of electric current** through them
